title: Diagnose broken-overflow test page layout issue

log: Screenshot at 1400px: content displays normally, 'Status panel' heading visible, text wraps correctly.

Screenshot at 400px (narrow mobile): text overflows right edge, horizontal scroll required. Content text states: 'This status line is pinned to a fixed width wider than the page, so narrow screens see it run off the right edge instead of wrapping.'

diagnosis: Root cause: page.js line 18 applies inline style `width: 900px` to a div element. This fixed width is wider than any narrow viewport (e.g., 400px), forcing horizontal overflow instead of text wrapping. The div contains text describing the exact problem, confirming the issue is intentional for testing purposes.

fix: Remove or conditionally apply the fixed width. Replace `.style('width', '900px')` with either: (1) no width style at all (let content reflow), or (2) use `max-width: 900px` instead of fixed width, which allows shrinking on narrow screens while staying at 900px on wide screens.
